name: Thran Khorman
summary: At Anvilmar, Thran Khorman trains new warriors for the dangers of Coldridge Valley.

sections.title: Drillmaster of Coldridge Valley
sections.body: Thran Khorman drills dwarven recruits and visiting gnomes on the grounds of Anvilmar. Gruff and demanding, he has little patience for anyone who lacks the grit for front-line fighting. Though the Third War has ended, troggs press into Coldridge Pass, and danger still fills the mountains. Thran insists on relentless practice with axe, mace, and shield so Ironforge’s defenders stay ready.

faq.answer: Thran Khorman trains warriors at Anvilmar in Dun Morogh. He gives novice warriors their first combat instruction in Coldridge Valley.
Thran teaches novice warriors the fundamentals of martial combat, including stances and melee techniques. He prepares them to face the troggs and wild beasts of the pass.

faq.q: Why is he dismissed or curt with certain travelers?
faq.answer: Thran has little patience for those who pursue arcane, shadow, or subtle arts. If you are not a warrior, he will tell you plainly that you would not survive a day under his training.

angles.text: As a dwarven or gnomish warrior awakening in Coldridge Pass, Thran is the first master to test your mettle, give you your starter runes or orders, and teach you the basics of martial survival.
As a dwarf, you can see in Thran the stubborn resolve of Ironforge’s defenders. He keeps them ready even in peacetime, so the kingdom is never caught unprepared.
